notes.title: Update | The Endless mode
notes.notes:
Endless mode!

This update introduces a brand new game mode! Climb an infinite tower, escaping from the growing sludge at the bottom!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44912128/85c2735c3bf1fb83c26e29511b5d00615150d81e.png

Compete with others, for the highest score on the leaderboard!

https://steamcommunity.com//stats/2587870/leaderboards/16658740

The infinite tower is randomly generated from pre-made sections, making every run different!


Minor bug fixes

- crouching has been reworked (added a smooth transition between the standing and crouching state; the way the player's collider work, has been changed)

- lighting issues fixed [spoiler] at that dark area [/spoiler]

Minor rework

- [spoiler] That dark area has been a bit reconstructed, adding one more office [/spoiler]

- replaced logo in main menu and credits

- chapters are now always unlocked

notes.title: Small Bugfixes
notes.notes:
The update contains a few smaller fixes:

- few missing colliders have been placed
- an unnecesary invisible wall have been remowed
- the volume of the fire alarms have been greatly reduced
- fixed a softlock opportunity
- fixed a chance to fall out of bounds
